transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Buses 93, 94 and 95 connect the airport directly with St Peter Port Bus Terminus. Route 71 runs to St Peter Port via Princess Elizabeth Hospital. Cash is not accepted: payment is contactless or with Concession/Student cards.

taxi.title: Taxis
taxi.text: The licensed taxi rank is directly outside the terminal. Pre-booked vehicles have a separate area behind the rank. Licensed wheelchair-accessible taxis with shallow ramps are also available.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: The left luggage service opens daily from 09:00 to 17:00 for passengers who want to leave the airport before check-in. Luggage is security screened, and the facility is staffed and monitored by CCTV. Information is available at the Customer Services Information desk.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Both car parks are close to the terminal; the first 30 minutes are free. Drop-off and pick-up zones are directly outside the terminal. A parking ticket is issued on entry; payment before leaving is at machines in the main terminal, by cash or card, including contactless.

about: Guernsey Airport is in the parish of the Forest, in the south of the island.
